name: Vaarad Ventures Limited
about: Vaarad Ventures Limited, a non-banking financial company, engages in investment activities in India. It serves the technology, mineral water, weighing scales, supply chain management, and database management industries. The company was formerly known as Atco Corporation Limited and changed its name to Vaarad Ventures Limited in February 2011. Vaarad Ventures Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Mumbai, India.
